_what: The limits of an always-listening voice session (read-data/voice-session.mjs): it starts on a wake phrase or an explicit start, hears utterances while it is active, and ends by itself on silence, on its longest length, or on a spoken dismissal. Every phrase, number and word here is data. A phrase is compared as lower-case words with the punctuation removed; a dismissal counts when the whole utterance is that phrase, or the utterance ends with it after a pause word of `dismissal.lead_in`.

words.stopped_idle: Stopped listening after {seconds} seconds of quiet.
words.stopped_long: Stopped listening: the session reached its {seconds} second limit.
words.not_listening: Not listening. Say a wake phrase or start a session.
